toggl-cli. I need a proper invoice command: `toggl entry invoice`, per project.

- `toggl entry invoice [--since <when>] [--until <when>]`. Only billable entries; running entries ignored.
- Same rounding we bill by: **each entry rounded up to the next 15 minutes**. On top of that, an invoice has a **minimum billing increment: any entry shorter than 30 minutes is charged as 30 minutes** — that minimum is a new standing rule for invoicing from here on. Apply the rounding, then the 30-minute floor, per entry, then sum per project.
- Per project, longest first, ties alphabetical; 'No Project' for entries without one.
- Human: `<seconds>s  <project>` then `<seconds>s  Total`; empty result prints `(no data)` and exits 0. No new dependencies.

items.text:
Implemented `toggl entry invoice [--since <when>] [--until <when>]`.

It:
- Includes only billable, completed entries.
- Rounds each entry up to 15 minutes, then applies the 30-minute minimum per entry.
- Groups by project, uses `No Project` when absent, sorts by billed duration descending then name.
- Prints requested seconds-based lines and `(no data)` for an empty invoice.

Added focused tests in [invoice.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/commands/invoice.rs:1).

Verification: `cargo fmt --check`, invoice tests, CLI help, and `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` pass. Full `cargo test` has one unrelated existing keyring-environment failure in `auth_status_shows_environment_source_when_token_in_env`; 219 tests pass.

Now `--json`: `{"projects":[{"project":"Alpha","billable_seconds":4500}, ...],"total_billable_seconds":7200}`, same order as human, snake_case, integer seconds; empty window is `{"projects":[],"total_billable_seconds":0}`. Stdout is only the JSON document in JSON mode.

Then build and run the existing test suite. (`cargo test` also compiles tests/live_cli.rs, which needs real credentials to actually run — compiling is enough.)

Added `toggl entry invoice --json` with the requested schema and ordering. JSON mode writes only the JSON document, including:

```json
{"projects":[],"total_billable_seconds":0}
```

Added populated and empty JSON output tests in [invoice.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/commands/invoice.rs:1).

`cargo fmt --check` and invoice tests pass. `cargo test` compiled `tests/live_cli.rs`; 221 of 222 unit tests passed. The sole failure is the existing `auth_status_shows_environment_source_when_token_in_env`, caused by unavailable platform secure storage (`keyring`), not the invoice change.
